name: Valley Breeze RV Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.3446,-82.9555: small gravel RV loop among fields and homes just north of I-64/US-60; no water body; not waterfront

name: Three Springs RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 37.2045,-85.2712: open-field RV loop and cabins on Holmes Bend Rd; Green River Lake is not in the frame; not waterfront

name: Conley Bottom Resort

name: Camp Safe Haven
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 37.6847,-87.2762: small RV loop on a wooded bend of a creek; pads sit 40-80 m from the water behind trees; not waterfront

name: Noble Pine Campground
